connector.name: Alephant MCP
connector.registryDescription: Alephant MCP server for AI cost control, BYO-key routing, 50+ providers, and 320+ models.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the alephantai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: ALEPHANT_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Alephant SaaS API base URL, for example https://alephant.io.

env.name: ALEPHANT_VIRTUAL_KEY
env.description: Virtual Key for read-only, cockpit-scoped VK mode. Use this mode for developer-level cost and usage visibility.

env.name: ALEPHANT_PAT
env.description: Personal Access Token for Manager mode. When set, Manager mode takes precedence over ALEPHANT_VIRTUAL_KEY.

env.name: ALEPHANT_WORKSPACE_ID
env.description: Workspace UUID required with ALEPHANT_PAT for Manager mode.

env.name: ALEPHANT_RATE_LIMIT_RPM
env.description: Optional local HTTP tool-call limit per minute. Defaults to 60; set 0 to disable local throttling.
